newsitem.title: FRANCE: UAP says Pfeiffer to head GAN.
newsitem.headline: UAP says Pfeiffer to head GAN.

text.p: Unions des Assurances de Paris said in a statement on Wednesday that Finance Minister Jean Arthuis had named UAP vice-president Didier Pfeiffer to replace state insurer GAN chairman Jean-Jacques Bonnaud.
Bonnaud was fired by government decree adopted on Wednesday after refusing to heed a call to resign in the wake of a failed tender to privatise GAN bank subsidiary CIC.

UAP said in the statement it regretted Pfeiffer's departure, that the empty post of vice-president would not be filled but that Eric Guily had been chosen to work directly with UAP chairman Jacques Friedmann in a general management role.
